dedicated.name: Velika's Traces of Truth

why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Velika by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story:
"Is this the famous Philosopher's Stone? It is. Though, I suppose it looks quite different than it used to."

Craving power surpassing the established natural order, Velika devoted herself to the dark magical arts and eventually obtained the Philosopher's Stone, reaching the pinnacle of her studies — only to find herself overcome by a profound sense of boredom with the world. But after time, she came to grasp a cosmic truth that transcends all limitations —even those of the Power of Destruction itself— and issued a stern warning to Sebastian: that he must handle the Traces of Truth, a treasure she had perfected by fusing the powers of the sages with her own magic, with the utmost care.

lore:
Velika, driven by her irresistible curiosity, set out to investigate the Power of Destruction that was beginning to spread across the Surface World. But no matter how gifted a Black Magician she was, controlling the Power of Destruction lay beyond her ability, and soon, a vicious Curse of Destruction burrowed deep into her body. Amid excruciating agony, Velika struggled desperately to cling to her sanity.

"Ghk...! Pain is only temporary. If I can just bring this power under my control...!"

As Velika writhed in pain, Dellons appeared before her. He told her that if she fully embraced the Power of Destruction, her suffering would vanish. Left with no other choice, Velika accepted the Power of Destruction, and in an instant gained immense magical powers. Having tasted that intoxicating power, she became his collaborator without hesitation, continuing her research into the Power of Destruction and her experiments to create the ultimate lifeform.

"Hahaha! It feels like I've taken another step closer to the truth of the universe!"
